_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail: NanoLimbo, a tiny limbo server for Minecraft Java (1.7.2 to 26.x clients): players wait in an empty world, usually sent there by a Velocity or BungeeCord proxy when their server is down or full. The install takes NanoLimbo.jar from Nan1t/NanoLimbo's GitHub releases (latest or a version; pre-releases refused), checked against the SHA-256 digest GitHub lists (1.12.0 and newer have one; older releases are refused), and copies settings.yml out of the jar when there is none, so the panel sets bind.ip and bind.port before the first start (NanoLimbo's default binds localhost:65535). NanoLimbo 1.13 needs Java 21. Not tagged minecraft: NanoLimbo has no server.properties, plugins, mods or versions, so none of the Minecraft tools apply (the version changer would replace it with another server); it has no say command either, so no broadcast. No EULA (not a Mojang server).
name: NanoLimbo
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: NanoLimbo is a lightweight limbo server for Minecraft: Java Edition: players wait in an empty world instead of being disconnected, for example while a proxy restarts their server. It takes a few dozen MB of memory and supports clients from 1.7.2 to the newest release.

startup_commands.Default: if [ ! -f {{SERVER_JARFILE}} ]; then echo 'The NanoLimbo jar is missing: reinstall the server (Settings, Reinstall).'; exit 1; fi; exec java -Xms32M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=95.0 -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# NanoLimbo installation (Octail): NanoLimbo.jar from Nan1t/NanoLimbo's GitHub releases (latest or a version),
# checked against the SHA-256 digest GitHub lists for the asset; releases without one (1.8.1 and older) are
# refused. settings.yml is taken from the jar when there is none, so the panel can set the bind address and port
# before the first start; the owner's settings.yml stays on reinstall.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

fail() {
	echo "Installation failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 60 --retry 3 "$1"; }

VERSION="${LIMBO_VERSION:-latest}"
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-nanolimbo.jar}"
echo "${VERSION}" | grep -Eq '^(latest|v?[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?)$' ||
	fail "the NanoLimbo version (${VERSION}) must be a version such as 1.13.0 or latest"
echo "${JAR}" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.jar$' || fail "the jar file name (${JAR}) must be a plain name ending in .jar"

RELEASES=https://api.github.com/repos/Nan1t/NanoLimbo/releases
if [ "${VERSION}" = latest ]; then
	RELEASE=$(get "${RELEASES}/latest") || fail "GitHub didn't list the latest NanoLimbo release"
else
	# Tags are v1.13.0 from 1.8 on (1.7 and older have no v); both spellings are tried.
	RELEASE=$(get "${RELEASES}/tags/v${VERSION#v}") || RELEASE=$(get "${RELEASES}/tags/${VERSION#v}") ||
		fail "NanoLimbo ${VERSION} isn't a release on GitHub"
fi
TAG=$(echo "${RELEASE}" | jq -r '.tag_name // empty')
[ -n "${TAG}" ] || fail "GitHub's answer names no release"
if [ "$(echo "${RELEASE}" | jq -r '.prerelease')" = true ]; then
	fail "${TAG} is a pre-release; pick a release version"
fi
URL=$(echo "${RELEASE}" | jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name == "NanoLimbo.jar")][0].browser_download_url // empty')
SUM=$(echo "${RELEASE}" | jq -r '[.assets[] | select(.name == "NanoLimbo.jar")][0].digest // empty' |
	sed 's/^sha256://' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
[ -n "${URL}" ] || fail "release ${TAG} has no NanoLimbo.jar (1.12.0 and newer have one)"
echo "${SUM}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' || fail "GitHub lists no SHA-256 for NanoLimbo.jar of ${TAG}"

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
echo "Installing NanoLimbo ${TAG} as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 600 --retry 3 -o "${JAR}.download" "${URL}" ||
	fail "the download of NanoLimbo ${TAG} failed"
if ! echo "${SUM}  ${JAR}.download" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "NanoLimbo.jar of ${TAG} doesn't match its SHA-256 (${SUM})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

# NanoLimbo's default settings.yml binds localhost:65535; the panel sets bind.ip and bind.port before every start,
# so the first start needs the file already there.
if [ ! -f settings.yml ]; then
	unzip -p "${JAR}" settings.yml >settings.yml.new || fail "${JAR} carries no settings.yml"
	[ -s settings.yml.new ] || fail "${JAR} carries no settings.yml"
	mv settings.yml.new settings.yml
fi

echo "NanoLimbo ${TAG} installed (SHA-256 ${SUM} checked). Its settings are in settings.yml."
echo "Behind Velocity or BungeeCord, set infoForwarding there to match the proxy's forwarding."

variables.name: NanoLimbo Version
variables.description: The NanoLimbo release to install, such as 1.13.0, or latest for the newest release. 1.12.0 and newer only (older releases have no published checksum). Applied on the next reinstall.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the NanoLimbo jar file.
